title: Separate database schema, migrations, backup import/export, stats, and repository implementations
description: TASK-024 records storage ports, but AstrBot's database and backup layers also show migration, stats, API key, persona, cron, project/session, import, and export concerns that should not collapse into one persistence module.

files.change: Keep repository traits, concrete SQL implementations, migration runner, backup export/import, and stats queries in separate modules.
Expose persistence through management services instead of direct DB access in HTTP route handlers.

criteria: Storage ports remain independent from concrete SQLite or backup format code.
Migrations are ordered, idempotent, and testable with temporary stores.
Backup import/export does not depend on dashboard route handlers.
